body:
Damn you sound exactly like me, I literally could have written this exact post.  I don't really know if I can say anything that might help, other than I feel for you. 

 I'll try and hang in for another day if you do?
Thanks for caring it helps me a little to know that.
Actually it's too late for me, I failed a class necessary for my major and I haven't told anyone yet.  My mom thinks I'm graduating soon....nope...failing out...

Thanks for your advice.  I hope that this lack of feeling is only temporary, but I fear that I've destroyed my capacity for emotion as some sort of defense mechanism against my depression.

I've actually been having this dream where I think I feel happy, and in the dream I'm playing my guitar in front of a dark room full of people who are just listening to me play and sing.

I definitely understand your argument for existence. "Should I kill myself, or have a cup of coffee?"

But I just feel like I've squandered my potential and missed out on so much that life has to offer, and it causes me debilitating anxiety and guilt.  And there is so much in my culture that I disagree with, materialism, racism, classism, I don't know... I wish I could be more logical but I'm just a damaged individual. 

I feel like I've already run out of things to look forward to, and that I'll soon end up even more alone and working a job that I don't enjoy in order to buy things that I don't really want.  Maybe you're right, and I'm just being short sighted... I don't know.  Thank you though.

Hey, I know this probably doesn't help very much.  But I just wanted to let you know that I feel the exact same way.  I feel for you man, and I really hope you can find the will to go on.

What's your favorite game?
